_doc: Props made with Artlist (AI Suite plan): concept image (Nano Banana 2), then image-to-3D (Hyper3D Rodin v2.5 Fast). The generated GLBs go in .cache/props/<name>.glb; tools/props/import_prop.py makes game/Assets/Props/<name>.glb. Credits are logged in docs/ASSETS.md.
